name: cyprus-social-contributions
description: Cyprus Social Insurance and General Healthcare System (GHS) contributions for tax year 2026, under the Social Insurance Law 59(I)/2010, the Contributions Regulations K.D.P. 289/2010 and the GHS Law 89(I)/2001. Covers employees, employers, the self-employed, voluntary contributors, pensioners and people with rent, interest or dividends: Social Insurance at 8.8% plus 8.8%, 16.6% self-employed on the 16 occupational category minimums or on actual earnings, the 2026 maximum insurable earnings (EUR 5,742 a month, EUR 1,325 a week), the 2026 self-employed quarters and their 10 May, 10 August, 10 November and 10 February due dates, GHS at 2.65%, 2.90% and 4.00% with the EUR 180,000 maximum, the Redundancy, HRDA (0.5% for the self-employed in 2026), Social Cohesion and Central Holiday funds, late charges of 3% to 27%, and the one-fifth cap. Trigger on: Cyprus social insurance 2026, GESY contribution, GHS on dividends, self-employed category Cyprus, quarterly social insurance Cyprus, insurable
